title: The ledger's own page is titled "." because the project name was never set
foundBy: session agent, walking README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: ledger/ledger.json carries "project": "sandbox", and the rendered page's title reads "sandbox · ledger" where it read ". · ledger".

details:
`ledger/ledger.json` carries `"project": "."`, so every render titles the page `. · ledger` and the masthead names the project `.`. The sibling repositories carry `ledger`, `tracer` and `vcr`.

The page is published, so the name is the first thing a reader sees.
